samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for performing various operations on two 32-bit inputs.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input 'a'</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input 'b'</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result of the operation</assign>
        <assign id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]">Shift amount for shifting operations</assign>
        
        <always_comb>
            <case id="operation_selection">
                <when condition="'d0'>='d0 && 'd0<'d64">
                    <if condition="aluc == ADD">
                        res <= signed_a + signed_b;
                    </if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == ADDU">
                        res <= a + b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SUB">
                        res <= signed_a - signed_b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SUBU">
                        res <= a - b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == AND">
                        res <= a & b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == OR">
                        res <= a | b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == XOR">
                        res <= a ^ b;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == NOR">
                        res <= ~(a | b);
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SLT">
                        res <= {31'd0, (signed_a < signed_b)};
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SLTU">
                        res <= {31'd0, (a < b)};
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SLL || aluc == SLLV">
                        shift_amount <= a[4:0];
                        res <= b << shift_amount;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SRL || aluc == SRLV">
                        shift_amount <= a[4:0];
                        res <= b >> shift_amount;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == SRA || aluc == SRAV">
                        shift_amount <= a[4:0];
                        res <= $signed(b) >>> shift_amount;
                    </else_if>
                    <else_if condition="aluc == LUI">
                        res <= {a[15:0], 16'd0};
                    </else_if>
                    <default>
                        res <= 32'dZ;
                    </default>
                </end_when>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
        
        <assign id="zero" width_description="[0:0]">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero</assign>
        <assign id="carry" width_description="[0:0]">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation</assign>
        <assign id="negative" width_description="[0:0]">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative</assign>
        <assign id="overflow" width_description="[0:0]">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation</assign>
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU)</assign>
        
        <assign zero = (res == 32'd0);
        <assign carry = (res > 32'hFFFFFFFF);
        <assign negative = (res[31] == 1);
        <assign overflow = ((aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) && (signed_a[31] != signed_b[31]) && (signed_a[31] != res[31]));
        <assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? res[0] : 1'bz;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Described above.</implementation>
</module>
